::: researchcontainer


Early on in my academic career, I made an intentional commitment to focus my efforts on learning the tools that best facilitate open science. I am an advocate for the use of **open-source geospatial code, tools, and data**. I am most comfortable coding in **R** or **Python**, although I occasionally use **Javascript** and **Bash** for specific geospatial applications. I am also a **QGIS** plugin developer and I have a great love for the open-source GIS ecosystem and community.
:::
